name: paciencia-95
description: Recriação do clássico Paciência (Klondike) do Windows 95 com React/Vite e Rust/Axum.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/package-windows.ps1
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
